entries.title: Show HN: Content-aware fill for audio to change a song to any duration
entries.author: jaflo
entries.current_title: Show HN: Mofi – Content-aware fill for audio to change a song to any duration
entries.excerpt: I worked on a web service that allows you to import a song and define a target length that the song will be shortened or lengthened to. It does this by analyzing the song and finding repeating audio patterns. This is helpful for making any song match a video or performance with a set duration. You can also specify areas of the song to prefer or avoid. An example is available here: https://mofi.loud.red/edit/8bd3fdf780f8c3927e41029f3b957f8a7... The cool thing is that after the
entries.guide_zh: 分析歌曲中的重复结构，按目标时长延长或缩短音频以适配视频。

entries.title: Show HN: I've built open-source, collaborative, WYSIWYG Markdown editor
entries.author: arek_nawo
entries.current_title: Show HN: An open-source, collaborative, WYSIWYG Markdown editor
entries.excerpt: Inspired by the design and UI/UX of apps like Notion, and utility of open-source apps like StackEdit, I decided to create a minimalistic, local-only WYSIWYG Markdown editor. Some features worth highlighting: - Monaco editor and Prettier integration for code snippets - Tables (apparently the holy grail of WYSIWYG editing) - Embeds (for CodePen, CodeSandbox and YouTube, most useful for HTML or JSON exports) - Accepts Markdown paste-in, and "exports"/generates HTML, Markdown and
entries.guide_zh: 受 Notion 与 StackEdit 启发，作者制作开源协作式所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器。

entries.author: dialupdotnet
entries.current_title: Show HN: WinGPT – AI assistant for Windows 3.1
entries.excerpt: Hey HN, I didn't want my Gateway 4DX2-66 from 1993 to be left out of the AI revolution, so I built an AI Assistant for Windows 3.1, based on the OpenAI API. The most interesting parts of building this were: - Getting TLS 1.2 and 1.3 working on Windows 3.1 so that WinGPT could directly connect to OpenAI's server without relying on a modern machine for TLS termination. - Learning about the memory segmentation architecture on 16-bit Windows, including the difference between far
entries.guide_zh: 为 1993 年的老电脑接入 AI，作者制作 Windows 3.1 助手 WinGPT。

entries.title: Show HN: Indexing Discord content into the web – Answer Overflow
entries.author: rhyssullivan1
entries.current_title: Show HN: Answer Overflow  – Indexing Discord content into the web
entries.excerpt: Hi! I'm Rhys, I develop Answer Overflow a search engine for Discord channels. Answer Overflow indexes content from channels into Google making them discoverable on the web. I'm sharing this again after seeing a lot of discussion during the Reddit blackout about the inaccessibility of information sent in Discord servers. Answer Overflow is a verified bot in over 100 communities, fully complies with the Discord ToS, and is open source! https://github.com/AnswerOverflow/AnswerOv
entries.guide_zh: Answer Overflow 将 Discord 频道内容索引到网页，让搜索引擎能够发现答案。
